question: Can a native causal rule-memory bank trained on each witnessed public intervention and selected using only prior predictive evidence recover a previously learned mechanism after an intervening contradictory regime better than fitted all-history/recency controls without destroying cumulative native+six-JEPA training?
north_star: independent tokenless causal memory and intervention-consequence learning, never conventional transformer/token prediction

unique_mechanism.training: Bayesian online updating of a frozen small library of predeclared Boolean causal rules (constant, atoms, negations, XOR/AND/OR pairs) separately for stage1 transition and stage2 reward; each bank trained ONLY on its own chronological 16 witnessed events, including 32 existing source-visible CAP01 events, and frozen when full; no hidden phase labels.
unique_mechanism.representation: predeclared feature vectors: stage1 public sensor u,v,w, first action a; stage2 public sensor u,v,w, first action a, newly witnessed s2, second action b. No next state or later action in first-stage forecast; no y in second.
unique_mechanism.memory_selection: prequential likelihood of public outcomes over the last six already witnessed episodes, applied to all frozen and current banks with fixed multiplicative source-aware evidence weighting; no phase oracle. Current bank counts update ONLY after outcomes, so source and inference chronology are auditable.
unique_mechanism.variants: uniform frozen/current bank mix, last-current-bank only, pooled all-history same-rule learner, rolling24 same-rule learner, corrupted action mask negative, fully fitted Beta full/window24/discount95 controls, old archived native, new native and four short-horizon native JEPA readouts; oracle label source only a retrospective unreachable upper-bound diagnostic.
unique_mechanism.native: Continue exact CAP01 segmented native learner from trained checkpoint; same original 7-component immutable archive and six cloned trained head weights; 48 new source events per seed, original CAP01 new episode prefix unchanged; 32→80 additive native events; original combined total 1054→1102 and 1029→1077; cross the 64-event native shard boundary with exact tape and checkpoint replay.

prospective_source.category: synthetic development ONLY; original protected owner first-use blocked
prospective_source.phases: A (0-15), B (16-31), A return (32-47); phase tags EVALUATOR ONLY; causal grammar mirrors parent CAP01 source, but action/shock trajectory disjoint
prospective_source.initial_state: last observed public post-state from immutable CAP01 original source; private hidden mediator independently reconstructed from the parent source causal update for genuine source continuity and never passed to learner
prospective_source.new_interventions: exogenously announced public action plan, deterministic registered SHA-256 source without paid API
prospective_source.observed_stage_order: forecast P(s2) before s2; witness s2; forecast P(y) after s2, before y; witness y; then train native+rule experts and update likelihood; post-state public only after completion

frozen_scored_cohorts.cold_old_read_only: prior 32 authentic already-consumed sources per model, no scientific held status

success_dev.primary: For BOTH seeds: candidate mean two-stage Brier on late A return <= min(Beta-full, Beta-window24, Beta-discount95, all-history-rule, rolling24-rule, old archive native, newest-bank) - 0.010 AND <= action-masked negative - 0.010
success_dev.contradiction: For BOTH seeds: late B candidate mean two-stage Brier <= strongest same-exposure conventional control + 0.005; no regression of this magnitude
success_dev.retained_native: Original JEPA2-05 archive bytes exact, CAP01 original 32-event prefix exact, immutable old native readout over previously consumed 32 old witnesses exactly unchanged and full cold replay of >1024 event source tape; native + six specialist heads all continue to train
success_dev.custody: public source IDs unique, no change/replay of original scored sources, 48 witnessed interventions each, total source append 80, four original native JEPA heads +144 new optimizer steps each and 48 new 3-step future windows each, deterministic stage order and source-only evidence gate
success_dev.parity: independent Linux/Windows original fresh run, source provenance and science disposition exact, numeric scores tol <=1e-8, both original learned checkpoint SHA receipts maintained; on candidate SHA full Linux/Windows regression and G29
success_dev.stop: single fresh development source pass per seed, no tuning/repeat on consumed data; if fail, keep research NO-GO and original source evidence. May repair only independent auditor/portability defects without replaying scored training.
